description: This file contains a set of unit tests for testing silo shutdown scenarios in an Orleans distributed system. It includes tests for graceful shutdown workflows such as pending request forwarding, timer handling, and detecting stuck timers or activations. The tests leverage Orleans testing utilities and configure a test cluster with specific options, focusing on behaviors during silo deactivation and shutdown sequences.

classes.name: ShutdownSiloTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying various behaviors during silo shutdown in Orleans, including request forwarding, timer handling, and stuck activation detection.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Internal class implementing ISiloConfigurator to configure silo options such as clustering, deactivation timeout, and placement strategy.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Ensures that Azure Storage preconditions are met before tests run.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the Orleans test cluster with initial silos count and custom silo builder configurator.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_ForwardPendingRequest
methods.description: Test for forwarding of pending requests during silo shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_PendingRequestTimers
methods.description: Test for handling pending request timers during silo shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckTimers
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when timers become stuck during shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckActivation
methods.description: Test for detection and handling of stuck activations during silo shutdown.

methods.name: GetLongRunningTaskGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Helper method to obtain a long-running task grain hosted on a secondary silo.

methods.name: GetTimerRequestGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Helper method to obtain a timer request grain hosted on a secondary silo.
